guard: A scope's entry is stamped with the JOINED branch clock at settle, so now() after a scope is the same value live and on resume. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: the ok-path scope settle is stamped with the handler's clock at append time
mutations.expectRed: and the scope entry is stamped with that joined clock, not the handler's clock at append time
mutations.completionMarker: ok live, now() after a parallel is the join of the branch clocks
mutations.cell: and the scope entry is stamped with that joined clock, not the handler's clock at append time
mutations.note: The section 9 handler makes the last effect to LAND record the SMALLER clock (sb lands last at 4000; sa recorded 9000), so the handler's clock at settle is 4000 while the joined branch clock is 9000. Only the joined stamp keeps live and resume agreeing on now().
